name: PolyglotArchitectureRegistry
objective: Create the canonical registry that maps DUMMIE layers, languages, runtimes, source directories, specs, tests and ownership so the engine cannot forget its polyglot architecture.
why_now: P5 defined how truth is ranked. P6 must encode the physical polyglot architecture as canonical structured knowledge so future global tasks cannot collapse DUMMIE into a Python-only mental model.
must_not_create: runtime-heavy ContextQuant implementation before polyglot registry exists
success_conditions: specs mapped to layers where possible
tests mapped to language/layer where possible
future global tasks require polyglot coverage
